ARCHITECTURE SPRING 2031 UNDERGRADUATE ELECTIVE DESCRIPTIONS

ARCH 3600: Sustainable Design
TR 10:00-11:45am
Pat Example
This course explores the context of climate change and the urgency to implement integrated design,
identifying high-impact strategies, illustrated by case studies from the practice of architecture
and planning for the near future and beyond
